verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw is a law firm whose offering is legal advisory services, not a software product with a user interface whose features could be mirrored through an API, so API-versus-UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any API or software product; its pages cover practice areas, publications and offices only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
